note.item: Requires Joomla 5.4 or 6 and PHP 8.1 or later.

addition.item: First release of Pretty Slider: a slider with the image, title and a short description of the articles in the selected categories.
Settings for the number of slides, article ordering and direction, image priority, description source and length, and the title element.
Autoplay with a pause button and a setting for the seconds per slide. Autoplay does not start for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
